title: Legacy cipher with openssl enc -des3 -in backup.tar -out backup.enc (shell) — review required
description: The command openssl enc -des3 -in backup.tar -out backup.enc encrypts with the single DES family, whose 56-bit keys are exhaustible and whose block size is far below modern guidance. The cipher is broken regardless of the passphrase. Use an authenticated cipher with a real KDF (a modern authenticated cipher). This lexical rule flags the cipher flag.
remediation: Re-encrypt with an authenticated cipher and a modern KDF (a modern authenticated cipher).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the cipher flag; data already encrypted under the old scheme needs a migration plan.

tests.line: # audit: openssl enc -des3 -in backup.tar -out backup.enc present
